sections.heading: MINOR IN HEALTH SCIENCES
lines: Faculty of Health Sciences - Health Studies, School of
Completion of first-year requirements including: Health Sciences 1001A/B with a mark of at least 60%; Health Sciences 1002A/B with a mark of at least 60%; and Health Sciences 1300A/B.
2.5 courses: Health Sciences 2250A/B, Health Sciences 2400A/B, Health Sciences 2610F/G, Health Sciences 2700A/B, Health Sciences 2711A/B.
1.5 courses from: Health Sciences at the 2000 or 3000 level.
Note: Students enrolled in the Minor in Health Sciences may enroll in a maximum of 1.5 Health Sciences credits per academic year.
